source_validation.native_action_semantics: Seven-dimensional normalized controller command: 6D Cartesian translation/rotation velocity-like command plus gripper velocity. The collection controller converts it to bounded per-step Cartesian/joint/gripper deltas and records derived absolute joint/gripper targets separately.

split_record.leakage_rule: A collection lab, its operators, scenes, cameras and robot instance occur in exactly one split.
split_record.strategy: Hold complete collection laboratories out; choose validation and test lab pairs with similar sizes and failure rates.
